description: To apply IIT, scientists decompose a substrate into units, assign their states, select a system boundary and temporal grain, and evaluate causal effects under interventions. In the reference implementation, PyPhi, these are supplied as inputs rather than derived from the physical substrate.
limitations: As reported in the preprint. IIT proposes intrinsic criteria for selecting units and grains (Marshall et al., 2026), and the paper asks whether those are uniquely grounded in the present state.
